verdict.rationale: Clerk's eve tool-call authorization guide says it can gate tool calls against the caller's permissions and scopes and 'broker OAuth for tools that need a provider token on the caller's behalf'. That is the core of delegated third-party token access for agents. The evidence is a single one-line claim with no detail on how the tokens work. Missing for 10: token lifetime and refresh behavior, how the user consent flow works, vault or storage semantics for provider tokens, which providers are supported, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
